votes.motion: Accept the minutes from November 14, 2019 as written
votes.quote: a motion was made to accept as written by commissioner mendoza, seconded by chair tyler . it was voted unanimously by roll call vote to accept.
a motion was made by commissioner mendoza to adjourn, seconded by chair tyler . on a roll call vote it was voted unanimously to adjourn at 7:00 pm

votes.motion: Accept the January 16, 2020 meeting minutes as written
votes.quote: a motion was made to accept the minutes as written and duly seconded. by roll call vote it was voted unanimously to accept the minutes

votes.motion: Approve the draft letter concerning the Winter burial policy
votes.quote: a motion to approve said letter , that was duly seconded, it was approved unanimously by roll call vote to approve the letter

votes.motion: The Commission will not submit a warrant article for the 2020 Annual Town Meeting appropriation
votes.quote: motioned that the commission would not submit a warrant article for this year's atm for an appropriation. after being duly seconded it was voted unanimously by roll call vote

votes.motion: Spend $560.00 to add the Columbarium/Niche wall to the Ramaker software
votes.quote: a motion was made to spend $560.00 to make this addition. after being duly seconded, it was voted unanimously by roll call vote to proceed
motioned to adjourn, seconded, and voted by roll call to adjourn at 7:45 pm
